note: Eval set in the agentskills.io evals/evals.json format, graded deterministically by scripts/grade.js. Static assertions are regex contracts over SKILL.md; live assertions need a real merged PR + gh run and are recorded as not-run (excluded from pass-rate denominators).

evals.prompt: /vi-close-pipeline 294 (PR merged, issue closed by the merge)
evals.expected_output: Agent confirms the PR is MERGED, closes the issue only via the documented missing-Closes path, then sweeps stale artifacts through signal-based discovery and the two-gate obsolescence test, never deleting live knowledge, handling dead code only with zero-reference proof plus targeted tests, and finishes with the mandatory Clean Exit Gate - reporting everything in the Hebrew contract template.

static_assertions.why: no closeout step may run on an unmerged PR
the fallback issue-close path references the missing Closes keyword
candidates are detected by signals, never by assumed folder layout
deletion requires closed work AND zero inbound references
presentations and research are permanent record, even when closed
the single code-change exception needs mechanical proof plus tests
foreign dirt must be listed, never bundled into the prune commit
the pipeline is not closed until every exit check passes
the Hebrew closeout report is a hard contract of this skill

live_assertions: The PR is confirmed MERGED before any action
Stale artifacts are pruned only when both obsolescence gates pass
The repo ends on the base branch, pushed, synced, and spotless
The Hebrew closeout report names the PR, the issue, every deletion, and the exit-gate state
